locations.name: Village Square
locations.description: A bustling square with cobblestone paths, a central stone fountain, and lively townsfolk.

locations.name: The Prancing Pony
locations.description: A cozy tavern filled with warmth, the aroma of roasted stew, and friendly banter.

locations.name: Tavern Cellar
locations.description: A cool, shadowy cellar stacked high with dusty barrels and gnawed grain sacks.

locations.name: Ancient Catacombs
locations.description: Chilly subterranean passages carved into the bedrock, lined with old stone arches.

locations.name: Forgotten Crypt
locations.description: A cold, quiet burial chamber housing the stone sarcophagus of an ancient knight.

locations.name: Whispering Woods
locations.description: A quiet forest path sheltered by tall pines. Golden sunlight filters through the needles.

locations.name: General Store
locations.description: Shelves packed with adventuring gear, provisions, and curiosities from distant lands.

locations.name: Blacksmith & Armory
locations.description: The rhythmic clang of an anvil rings out near racks of freshly forged blades and armor.

items.name: Frothy Ale
items.description: A refreshing mug of tavern ale that restores 15 health.

items.name: Iron Sword
items.description: A sharp iron blade forged by Blacksmith Torin.

items.name: Healing Herbs
items.description: Fragrant wild herbs known for their soothing and medicinal qualities.

items.name: Old Lantern
items.description: A sturdy brass oil lantern that illuminates dark passages.

items.name: Silver Amulet
items.description: An engraved heirloom amulet belonging to Blacksmith Torin's family.

npcs.name: Village Guard
npcs.description: A vigilant guard in polished chainmail watching over the square.
dialogue: Stay safe, traveler. Keep your weapons sheathed in town.
Check the armory to the south if you need a sturdy blade.
Beware the tavern cellar—rats have been seen scurrying down there.

npcs.name: Shop Keeper
npcs.description: A cheerful merchant eager to trade goods with passing adventurers.
dialogue: I buy rare curiosities if you find any in the catacombs.

npcs.name: Blacksmith Torin
npcs.description: A muscular dwarf covered in soot, shaping steel at his forge.
dialogue: Need steel? I forge the finest blades around.
My family's silver amulet was lost in the crypt beyond the catacombs.
Bring it back to me, and I'll reward you with an iron sword!

npcs.name: Giant Cellar Rat
npcs.description: A snarling rodent the size of a hound with sharp yellow incisors.

npcs.name: Crypt Skeleton
npcs.description: An ancient reanimated skeleton clutching a rusted spear.
dialogue: *Bones clatter ominously as faint blue embers burn in its eye sockets.*

quests.title: The Blacksmith's Heirloom
quests.description: Retrieve Blacksmith Torin's lost silver amulet from the Forgotten Crypt.

reward.dialogue_complete: My grandfather's amulet! Thank you, adventurer. Take this sword as your reward!

quests.title: Cellar Trouble
quests.description: Clear the Giant Cellar Rat from the tavern cellar to secure the village supplies.

reward.dialogue_complete: Well done! The tavern cellar is safe again. Have a drink on us!
